🎬 Spirited (2022)

Spirited follows the Ghost of Christmas Present, a supernatural guide who spends every Christmas helping troubled individuals rediscover kindness and change their lives. When he chooses Clint Briggs, a cynical and manipulative media consultant, as his next person to redeem, he quickly discovers that this assignment is unlike anything he has experienced before. Clint refuses to follow the traditional lessons of Christmas and instead begins questioning the ghost’s own past, turning their magical journey into an unexpected adventure filled with hilarious situations, emotional discoveries, and spectacular musical performances. As the two explore memories, relationships, and the consequences of their choices, they begin learning important lessons about forgiveness, friendship, and personal growth. Starring Will Ferrell, Ryan Reynolds, and Octavia Spencer, the film delivers energetic musical numbers, laugh-out-loud comedy, and a heartwarming story about redemption, second chances, and the true meaning of Christmas.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Musical • Fantasy • Christmas

⭐ IMDb: 6.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h 7m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Sean Anders

✍️ Writers: Sean Anders & John Morris

📚 Inspired By: Charles Dickens’ classic novella A Christmas Carol.

📺 Where to Watch: Apple TV+ in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Spirited is a 2022 American Christmas musical comedy film directed by Sean Anders, and written and produced by Anders and John Morris, with songs by Benj Pasek and Justin Paul. It is a modern retelling of Charles Dickens's 1843 novella A Christmas Carol and a satire of the various adaptations since. The film stars Will Ferrell, Ryan Reynolds, Octavia Spencer, Sunita Mani, Patrick Page, Andrea Anders, Marlow Barkley, Joe Tippett, Jen Tullock, and Tracy Morgan. In the film, the Ghost of Christmas Present is nearing retirement, which would mean a return to Earth, and sets his sights on an "unredeemable" man named Clint Briggs, who ends up helping the Ghost come to terms with his own past.
